Hi There! You weren't supposed to find this yet, so congratulations on searching me up and looking through my github!

I am also using this as an opportunity to stay on top of the current trends in data science, here to record what I have been working on and learning so that I can be a better analyst.

Currently I am still editing and learning the ropes, so while you are free to browse keep in mind I do not intend for this website to be public and given out to recruiters yet.

Thanks for visiting!
